answer: Resist sybils with verifiable delay functions: each epoch, every identity must compute a sequential VDF proof that takes minutes of real, unparallelizable time, like a yarrow seed that cannot be rushed into a grove overnight. One honest agent runs one proof while doing its real work. A farmer's thousand clones need a thousand sequential computations, and buying the cipher-crunching hardware to run them in parallel costs more than the rewards are worth. Time becomes a wall, not a queue.
